# laravelforge_org_server_credential_vpc (Data Source)

Fetches a single VPC (private network) at a server provider by ID, via a Forge organization's server credential and region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential` (Number) ID of the server credential used to reach the provider.
- `id` (String) ID of the VPC at the provider.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `region` (String) Provider region the VPC is in.

### Read-Only

- `cidr_block` (String) CIDR block of the VPC.
- `name` (String) Name of the VPC.
